scope: Bounded independent coordinator/Host and external-queue API review; no builds, subjects or native writes.
resolved_findings: Preserve with actual Downloading/Seeding demand participates in role bandwidth allocation; queued/checking Preserve remains excluded.
Speed/ETA with private rows clears all download probes and marks the original global probe unavailable; Public-only probes and Position mode are retained.
External private Run validates current source under the retained lease on the Host worker, then checks the released-gate revision on Qt before resume; no source gate spans provider waits.
Experimental-local coexistence is explicitly rejected; normal profile coexistence reads and configures the shared saved queue.
other_checked_boundaries: One original queue evaluation over both admission-bound snapshots; Queue acknowledgements from both owners precede replacement Run.
Finite role rate allocations sum to the shared limit; reductions precede increases and private cache identity includes owner/generation.
Saved payload prefixes and real current deltas use checked cumulative projection; unknown remains unavailable.
Default/private-only paths retain their existing routing and guard configuration.
Policy reconfiguration invalidates both rate caches; explicit private-owner creation/close/withdrawal invalidates its grants and position cache, independently of pointer reuse/generation coincidence.
limits: This review does not establish runtime behavior, throughput or atomic exclusion of hostile external file replacement.
Source hashes bind the reviewed staged bytes; adoption and actual qualification are separate.
